hypotheses.P0_train_spectral_energy_is_accounted: The eigenvalues of the discovery Gram matrix account for its directly measured Frobenius energy to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.P1_rank64_operator_atlas_is_sufficient: The fixed FineWeb rank-64 spectral atlas retains at least 0.80 oracle-projection fidelity at every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.P2_rank128_operator_atlas_is_high_fideli: The fixed rank-128 spectral atlas retains at least 0.90 oracle-projection fidelity at every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.P3_rank128_state_predictor_is_sufficient: Ridge prediction from the local normalized state into the rank-128 atlas retains at least 0.80 fidelity at every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.P4_state_prediction_nearly_matches_oracl: At rank 128, state-predicted fidelity is within 0.10 of oracle spectral projection at every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.P5_state_predictor_transfers_ood: At rank 128, each OOD state-prediction fidelity is within 0.10 of FineWeb at every layer.
hypotheses.P6_spectral_rank64_beats_512_native_chan: Rank-64 oracle spectral fidelity exceeds the prior 512-channel native-bank fidelity by at least 0.20 at every matched layer and corpus.
hypotheses.P7_spectrum_has_nonrandom_outliers: At every layer, the real leading singular-value energy share is at least 1.5 times the maximum of four independent sign-randomized nulls.
hypotheses.P8_layer16_is_more_native_than_spectral_: Layer 16's advantage over Layers 13--15 is at least 0.20 for native-512 fidelity but less than 0.10 for rank-64 spectral fidelity on FineWeb.
